T: Pink house, perfect waffles, party every night.
D: Barbie's perfect life in Barbieland starts to crack, sending her and Ken into the real world.
P: Serve the waffles when Barbie's perfect morning starts to go wrong.
S: King prawns in pink cocktail sauce, served in small cups

Cold king prawns and crisp cos in little glasses, smothered in a pink Marie Rose sauce, finished with avocado, paprika and a lemon wedge. Peel and devein 600g cooked king prawns, leaving a few tails on for the tops. Mix 120g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp Worcestershire, a few drops of hot sauce and the juice of half a lemon until pink and smooth. Shred 1 cos heart and divide between 8 small glasses. Add diced avocado (1 total) and the prawns, spoon over the sauce, dust with paprika and add a lemon wedge.
Beach Ken watermelon and feta skewers
Watermelon, feta and cucumber cubes threaded with fresh mint

Chunks of icy watermelon threaded with feta, cucumber and mint, drizzled with lime and olive oil and dusted with chilli salt. Cut a quarter of a watermelon into 3cm cubes and chill well. Cut 200g firm feta and 1 continental cucumber into similar cubes. Thread onto 12 skewers in the order watermelon, mint leaf, feta, cucumber, watermelon. Lay on a platter, squeeze over the juice of 1 lime and drizzle with 2 tbsp olive oil. Mix 1 tsp salt with half a tsp chilli flakes and sprinkle over just before serving.
Girls' night beetroot pink devilled eggs
whites soaked magenta in pickling liquid, whipped mustard yolks, chives and crispy shallots

Boiled egg whites soaked hot pink in beetroot pickling liquid, filled with whipped mustard yolks and topped with chives and crispy shallots. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Mix 250ml liquid from a jar of sliced beetroot with 125ml white vinegar and 1 tbsp sugar, add the whole eggs and soak in the fridge for 2 to 4 hours until bright pink. Halve and pop out the yolks. Mash with 80g mayo, 2 tsp Dijon and salt until smooth, then pipe back in. Top with snipped chives and 2 tbsp fried shallots.
M: Penne in a roasted beetroot, ricotta and parmesan sauce
Pasta tossed in a sauce of roasted beetroot blended with ricotta, garlic and parmesan, topped with goat's cheese.
pork rubbed with paprika and sugar, baked low, glazed and charred, for the beach-off

Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, baked low until tender, then glazed with a sticky homemade barbecue sauce until charred at the edges. Heat the oven to 150C. Mix 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and pepper and rub over 2kg pork ribs. Wrap tightly in foil and bake 2.5 hours. Simmer 200ml tomato sauce, 60ml cider vinegar, 60g brown sugar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tsp smoked paprika for 10 minutes. Unwrap the ribs, brush with sauce and roast at 220C for 15 minutes, basting twice, until sticky.
W: Waffles, cream and strawberry sauce, minus the burnt one
Fluffy golden waffles piled with fresh strawberries, whipped cream and a bright pink strawberry sauce poured over the top.
K: Strawberry shake, white chocolate and sprinkle rim. The milk is fresh.

Fresh strawberries blended with vanilla ice cream and cold milk until thick and pink, in glasses rimmed with white chocolate and sprinkles. Melt 50g white chocolate and dip the rims of 4 tall glasses in it, then into 3 tbsp sprinkles. Chill the glasses 10 minutes. Blend 300g hulled strawberries with 500g vanilla ice cream, 300ml cold milk and 1 tbsp honey until thick and pink. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream (100ml whipped) and a halved strawberry.
